documents.title: Certificate under SEBI (Depositories and Participants) Regulations, 2018

analysis.summary: Krishana Phoschem Limited reported its Q1 FY27 earnings, highlighting a challenging operating environment due to global supply disruptions, elevated raw material costs, and geopolitical uncertainties in West Asia. Despite these hurdles, the company delivered strong year-on-year revenue and EBITDA growth, supported by backward integration, disciplined working capital, and the introduction of new complex fertilizer grades. Management expressed confidence in achieving robust capacity utilization and revenue growth for the remainder of FY27 as raw material availability stabilizes and monsoon conditions improve. Krishana Phoschem Limited reported its Q1 FY27 financial and operational performance, highlighting strong revenue and PAT growth driven by capacity utilization and integrated operations. Management outlined favorable industry dynamics supported by improving monsoons, higher MSP, and government subsidies such as NBS and PM-KISAN.

guidance.claim: Management expects to achieve an additional 30% to 35% turnover growth over last year.
guidance.quote: We are hoping that over the remaining quarters, we will be able to smoothen our production, and we will be able to achieve an additional 30%–35% turnover over last year.

guidance.claim: The company expects to achieve a quarterly turnover of more than 500 crore over the remaining three quarters of FY27.
guidance.quote: We expect to achieve a quarterly turnover of more than ₹500 crore over the remaining three quarters of FY27, supported by improved capacity utilization and production.

guidance.claim: Management expects to deliver growth of over 40% across key parameters during the current year.
guidance.quote: Accordingly, we expect to deliver growth of over 40% across key parameters during the current year.

guidance.claim: Management projects a top-line revenue increase of around Rs. 500 crore from the expanded capacity in FY27.
guidance.quote: So, you can expect a top line increase of around Rs. 500 crore. So, this year we had around Rs. 2,400 odd crore. So, you expect an increase of around Rs. 500 crore more, Rs. 2,900 to Rs. 3,000.

guidance.claim: Management expects overall revenue growth of 35% to 40% in FY27 including trading and manufacturing.
guidance.quote: Yes, including the import and manufacturing we expect 40% growth should not be a big issue.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that improved monsoon conditions, higher minimum support prices, and NBS support are expected to support fertilizer demand during the remainder of FY27.
demand_outlook.quote: Improving in monsoon conditions, higher MSP and continued government support through the Nutrient Based Subsidy (NBS) framework are expected to support the fertilizer demand during the remainder of FY27.

demand_outlook.claim: Improving monsoon conditions and higher MSP are supporting Kharif sowing and fertilizer demand.
demand_outlook.quote: Improving monsoon conditions, higher MSP & continued government backing through the Nutrient Based Subsidy (NBS) framework are creating a favourable operating environment.

demand_outlook.claim: The Kharif season demand environment appears constructive for the industry with comfortable domestic stock levels and favorable monsoon forecasts.
demand_outlook.quote: With comfortable domestic stock levels & a favourable monsoon forecast, the Kharif season demand environment appears constructive for the industry.

demand_outlook.claim: The quarter ended March 2026 witnessed stable demand dynamics during the Rabi season.
demand_outlook.quote: On the Rabi season, the quarter ended March ‘26, witnessed stable demand dynamics during the Rabi season.

demand_outlook.claim: Domestic manufacturers are not expected to face demand pressure given essential food consumption and domestic agricultural needs.
demand_outlook.quote: From our perspective, domestic manufacturers are unlikely to face demand pressure.

demand_outlook.claim: March saw a natural seasonal moderation in demand as key crops approached maturity.
demand_outlook.quote: March saw a natural seasonal moderation in demand as key crops such as wheat and mustard approached maturity consistent with typical fertilizer application cycles.

capex_expansion.claim: Management stated that the company is currently evaluating certain capacity expansion opportunities, which have not yet been approved or disclosed through statutory channels.
capex_expansion.quote: We are currently evaluating certain capacity expansion opportunities. Since these have not yet been approved or disclosed through the statutory channels, we are not in a position to share details at this stage.

capex_expansion.claim: Expanded capacities at Meghnagar include NPK/DAP at 165,000 MTPA and Sulphuric Acid at 99,000 MTPA.
capex_expansion.quote: Our expanded capacities at Meghnagar — NPK/DAP at 165,000 MTPA and Sulphuric Acid at 99,000 MTPA — are now contributing progressively to our performance.

capex_expansion.claim: The company successfully enhanced NPK/DAP capacity by 50% to 495,000 MTPA and maintained existing SSP capacity at 120,000 MTPA.
capex_expansion.quote: NPK/DAP capacity enhanced by 50% to 495,000 MTPA and existing SSP capacity at 120,000 MTPA, taking total phosphatic fertilizer capacity to 615,000 MTPA

capex_expansion.claim: Backward integration was strengthened with sulphuric acid capacity of 99,000 MTPA.
capex_expansion.quote: Backward integration strengthened with sulphuric acid capacity of 99,000 MTPA

capex_expansion.claim: The capacity expansion was funded through a prudent mix of internal accruals and term loans.
capex_expansion.quote: This expansion has been funded through a prudent mix of internal accruals and term loans, reflecting disciplined capital allocation.

capex_expansion.claim: The newly expanded capacity commenced production and is expected to stabilize over the next three to four months.
capex_expansion.quote: As our Managing Director mentioned, our new expansion has already commenced production and is expected to stabilize over the next three to four months.

margins_costs.claim: Management reported that EBITDA margins for the trading business are approximately 7% to 8% and around 16% for manufacturing.
margins_costs.quote: The EBITDA margin is approximately 7%–8% for trading and around 16% for manufacturing.

margins_costs.claim: The company has been able to pass on approximately 25% to 30% of the increase in input costs.
margins_costs.quote: Overall, we have been able to pass on ~ 25%–30% of the increase in input costs.

margins_costs.claim: Management stated that lower cost inventory carried forward from the previous quarter contributed to higher EBITDA margins.
margins_costs.quote: Yes, the inventory carried forward from the previous quarter at lower costs did contribute to the higher EBITDA margins.

margins_costs.claim: From mid-February onwards, the global market witnessed firming input cost trends driven by supply-side constraints, tightness in gas-linked production, and higher logistic and freight costs.
margins_costs.quote: However, from mid-February onwards, global market witnessed firming trends driven by supply-side constraints, tightness in gas-linked production, higher logistic and freight costs.

margins_costs.claim: Ammonia prices moved up sequentially during the quarter, and sulphur prices also firmed up towards March.
margins_costs.quote: As a result, ammonia prices moved up sequentially during the quarter. Sulphur prices also firmed up towards March.

margins_costs.claim: Profitability is expected to come down slightly during FY27 as input cost rises are absorbed to some extent.
margins_costs.quote: Yes, of course, we will absorb to some extent and as a result, our profitability is expected to come down slightly during the current year FY27.

margins_costs.claim: Backward integration has been a key contributor to higher EBITDA margins compared to peers.
margins_costs.quote: Backward integration has been a key contributor, which is why our EBITDA margins are higher than peers.

margins_costs.claim: Trading carries an EBITDA margin of around 5% to 6%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margin is 5% to 6% in in trading business.

orders_capacity.claim: During the quarter, the company achieved 43% capacity utilization of the NPK-DAP unit and 121% capacity utilization of the SSP unit.
orders_capacity.quote: 43% capacity utilization of NPK-DAP unit and 121% capacity utilization of SSP unit, which was beyond the core.

orders_capacity.claim: Total NPK-DAP capacity stands at 495,000 MT following an addition of 165,000 MT to the existing 330,000 MT capacity.
orders_capacity.quote: Our existing NPK-DAP capacity is 330,000 MT, and we have added another 165,000 MT, taking the total capacity to 495,000 MT.

orders_capacity.claim: Installed capacity stands at 6.15 Lakh MTPA.
The industry concluded Q4 FY26 with comfortable inventory levels of 177 lakh metric tonne.
orders_capacity.quote: The industry concluded Q4 FY26 with comfortable inventory levels of 177 lakh metric tonne indicating balanced supply-demand conditions and healthy channel inventory levels.

orders_capacity.claim: Total fertilizer production for the year reached 397,263 MT.
orders_capacity.quote: Achieved total production of 397,263 MT, supported by High demand across markets

orders_capacity.claim: NPK/DAP and SSP plants operated above rated capacity during the year.
orders_capacity.quote: Record high utilization levels in NPK/DAP and SSP plants operating above rated capacity, highlighting strong market acceptance and efficient asset utilization

risks_headwinds.claim: Geopolitical tensions in West Asia and shipping route uncertainties resulted in higher freight costs, delayed vessel movements, and increased procurement costs.
risks_headwinds.quote: The uncertainty surrounding shipping routes resulted in higher freight costs, delay in vessel movement, and increased procurement costs.

risks_headwinds.claim: Prices of key inputs such as ammonia, sulfur, phosphatic acid, and rock phosphate remained elevated.
risks_headwinds.quote: At the same time, prices of key inputs such as ammonia and sulfur increased, while phosphatic acid and rock phosphate prices also remained elevated, placing additional cost pressure on the industry.

risks_headwinds.claim: Input cost volatility and global supply uncertainties remain key monitorable risks.
risks_headwinds.quote: On the other hand, input cost volatility and global supply uncertainties remain key monitorable.

risks_headwinds.claim: Given the industry's reliance on imports for approximately 90% of key intermediates, global price movements have a direct impact on the cost structure.
risks_headwinds.quote: Given the industry's reliance on imports for ~90% of key intermediates, these global movements had a direct impact on cost structure.

risks_headwinds.claim: A timing mismatch occurred where domestic demand slowed down in March while input costs were increasing.
risks_headwinds.quote: This created a timing mismatch where domestic demand was slowed down in March while input costs were increasing, leading to higher cost pressure in the closing quarter.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that the green ammonia capacity agreement will start in FY29 after 2 years.
management_commitments.quote: And this capacity will start in FY29 after 2 years.

management_commitments.claim: Krishana Phoschem has entered into a 10-year Green Ammonia Sale Agreement under India's National Green Hydrogen Mission for 70,000 MTPA.
management_commitments.quote: Krishana Phoschem has entered into a 10-year Green Ammonia Sale Agreement (GASA) under India’s National Green Hydrogen Mission for 70,000 MTPA.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
